Overview

Talca is a city in ML with a population of 220,000. The heart of Chile’s wine country, surrounded by vineyards and known for its agricultural production. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
